No prior Kerala HC precedent directly on portal nomenclature was cited; the order is novel in mandating technical changes to a government IT system.

News Submissions blog@scconline.com Article Submissions articles@scconline.com Connect Follow Legal Channels --> Latest Updates 2026 SCC Vol. Patna High Court: In a writ petition
legal.contextNote: The Patna High Court, in a writ petition, set aside a Permanent Lok Adalat (PLA) award in a land dispute, declaring the award void ab initio. The Court held that under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, PLAs are confined to disputes concerning public utility services and lack jurisdiction to entertain or record compromises in property matters. No specific statute or section beyond the PLA's enabling provision is cited; no precedent directly on point is mentioned.
